refreshed: independent r4 readiness and original completed view ledgers

scope: Finite flattening of existing accepted r4 appendix observation records to original actually-viewed contact/native entries. No product re-review, new proof protocol, rendering or fresh image viewing.

coverage.first_page_obligation: All44 fresh first-page views remain mandatory.

method: Exact report/page/PNG SHA-256 joins between retained r4 accepted coverage entries and completed original observation lists; contact membership joins require exact contact path/hash and actual-view ledger membership.
Actual retained r4 appendix PNGs, selected original observation PNGs and selected contact images were SHA-256 rehashed; source JSON/markdown and declared contact-manifest bindings were checked.

Four historical terminal-page renumberings use explicit original prior_view/prior_own_observation mappings, preserved per-row as historical_page_mapping. No inferred page shifts, approximate matching or crop/masking.
Native evidence is preferred where an original completed native observation is available. CONTACT means layout-level observation only, never every-glyph native reading.

Original historical verdicts including REJECT/prototype feasibility remain recorded. Separate accepted r4 readiness/partition closure supplies closure attribution; no historical rejection relabelled as approval.
